name: TC Energy Corporation Preferred Shares (TRP.PR.D)
summary: TC Energy Corporation is a North American energy infrastructure company with five segments, covering natural gas pipelines in Canada, the United States and Mexico, liquids pipelines, and power and energy solutions. Its natural gas pipeline network moves gas from supply basins to LNG export terminals, other pipelines, industrial sites, power plants and local distributors, and it also holds regulated gas storage facilities.
